Terrain.description:
M13: the ground, absolute (sea level 0), on a grid of points `cell_m` apart from
(x0, y0), `nx` east by `ny` north, row by row from the south. `natural` is the ground the
spec shapes (hills, ridges, cliffs, flat districts, carved down to the water), `ground`
the finished ground (road corridors on their grade lines, embankments, retaining walls).
Every other z in the model is over the finished ground where it stands: a road's over its
`ground` profile, a node's over its `ground_m`, a building's over its `base_m`, anything
else over `ground` at its point.

WaterBed.description:
M16: the bed of a water body. Its depth at a point at distance d from the nearest
bank's line (the land's edge): 0 to the bank's waterline (`Bank.width_m` out), then
depth = toe + (D - toe) ramp(min(1, (d - width) / reach)), with the bank's `toe_m`, D the
body's `depth_m` (a river's or channel's at the nearest centerline point, `along`), and
ramp(u) = u (`shelf`), u (2 - u) (`channel`: deepest along the centerline, reach the half
width there) or 1 (`flat`: level between its walls).

reach_m.description: How far from the waterline the bed reaches its full depth (channel: the typical half width).
reach_m.title: Reach M

surface_m.description: The water surface over the ground datum: on a flat city -1.5 (the ground and the quay decks stand QUAY_DECK_M over every water body); None on a terrain city (M13's `terrain.water_levels`).
surface_m.title: Surface M

along.description: Rivers and channels: the depth at the centerline along it (s from its first point).
